annotations.title: What INITE sells, and for how much

description: INITE's services as a ladder, cheapest first: each step's id, name, price in the reader's currency and one line. `slug` gives one step in full, `full: true` all of them: what it delivers, how long it takes, the kind of price, the refund, and how it starts (a call with inite_book_call or a page to open).

full.description: true: every step in full instead of the summary.

lang.description: The reader's language; sets the currency (pt quotes reais) and the copy. Default en.

slug.description: One step in full, by the id the summary gives, e.g. "local".

name: inite_services
